messages.text: Friday, October 30 · Canton, Michigan
Foggy morning, warm afternoon, and a birthday wish

A foggy start gives way to a warm, clear afternoon with a high near 81°F. Today, Canton celebrates Ryan's birthday, while nearby Ann Arbor offers a variety of musical performances. In science, new findings from the James Webb Space Telescope shed light on early star formation.
Expect fog this morning, giving way to a warm day with a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F; there is a 3% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 8:05 AM and sunset is at 6:30 PM, with the moon in a Waning Gibbous phase, 78.3% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's afternoon and evening concerts
Attend Kathleen Beck's carillon performance at Burton Memorial Tower in Ann Arbor at 12:00 PM, or Tianyi Shen's clarinet recital at the Earl V. Moore Building at 8:00 PM; both are free events.
Today is Ryan's Birthday.
Ypsilanti library expands STEM access with Toyota support

The Ypsilanti District Library's Project STEM@YDL, supported by Toyota, has expanded STEM access for children and families since spring 2023. The initiative offers educational equipment, programming, and connections to STEM professionals.
Upcoming science and community events
Next week, the National Society of Black Physicists will hold a General Body Meeting and Board Games event in Ann Arbor on November 6th at 5:30 PM.

Saturday, October 31 · Canton, Michigan
Foggy mornings, starry nights, and a distant dwarf planet

A foggy start gives way to a warm autumn day, with a high near 81°F. The most compelling local news focuses on the Ypsilanti District Library's STEM initiative, while science brings news of a potential dwarf planet discovery and insights into Martian dust.
Expect fog today with a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F; there is a 3% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 8:06 AM, sunset at 6:28 PM, with the moon Last Quarter, 68.0% illuminated.
Evening entertainment options
For a unique evening, consider Murray Hill's "Showbiz! The Tour" at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM, or the psychological thriller "I'd Love to Have You for Dinner" in Hamtramck, also at 8:00 PM.
Mark your calendar for the 862 Meeting on November 4th at 6:30 PM.
Ypsilanti Library's STEM initiative gets Toyota support

The Ypsilanti District Library's Project STEM@YDL, with support from Toyota, has expanded STEM access for children and families since spring 2023. The initiative provides educational equipment, programming, and connections to STEM professionals, with 176 programs already offered.
Looking ahead to next week
The Southern Taurids meteor shower is expected to peak on November 4th, and the new moon will occur on November 9th.
